clarifications.reading: The 15 fixed random orders of the 20-slot reference book use seed 20261104, the US rehearsal registration's value.

Counted mature episodes split by entry ISO week at the calendar midpoint between the first and last counted entry weeks (empty weeks included); the middle week of an odd span is in the first half. One split serves the selection board halves and the bench bar's same-sign test.
A memo binds a fill only if finished before that market's regular cash close (local exchange time, DST-aware), not UTC midnight. A market without a close entry opens nothing.

change_markers.sealed_text: Section 2, Gates: 'A decline or sector verdict applies to sessions strictly after that store's as_of date.' Section 8, entry snapshot: facts 'read from files dated on or before that session.'
change_markers.what_was_wrong: The decline and sector stores are overwritten in place by ops-monitor with as_of set to the run date, just before the memo job and the forward dry run score the previous close. Readers took only the live file, so the one verdict they could see was always dated on or after the signal session and every signal failed parts 2 and 3 as store_after_session (ISO week 45: 0 of 101 entry-rule hits passed; forward dry run 2026-11-10: 411 candidates blocked on gate with gate_as_of 2026-11-10). The forward walker also saw a single gate observation per name, so the two-successive-declining-verdicts exit could never confirm.
change_markers.fix: Each gate refresh writes a dated copy to docs/data/gate_history/<gate>/<date>.json.gz (date = later of the store as_of and the UTC day it was generated). The memo job, evaluate_market and the forward job read the version dated strictly before each session (gate_store_history.GateHistory); the forward walker gets one gate fact per version date. Versions 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-10 were recovered from the committed store files in git history.
change_markers.no_lookahead: Strict reading kept: a version applies only to sessions after its date, and its date is never earlier than the day it was written. A session with no earlier version reads a stub with no verdicts and fails closed. as_of stays the run date rather than the data cutoff, because statement files are overwritten on fetch and may hold data published after the previous close.
change_markers.unchanged: No threshold, verdict rule, entry rule, exit rule or eligibility rule changed. The replay first score store (strategy_book_replay.json) is not re-run.
